name: Chaos Focus
description: Accelerating decay, breaking molecular bonds, inflicting curses, and channeling lethal negative energy.
body:
# Chaos Focus (Entropy)

Accelerating decay, breaking molecular bonds, inflicting curses, and channeling lethal negative energy.

### Mechanics
- **Parent Discipline**: Entropy
- **Damage**: `2d6 per Discipline Stage + 1d6 per Invocation Rank` (Necrotic / Chaos damage; ignores non-magical hardness and armor DR).
- **Curse**: Inflicts Disadvantage on target rolls for 1 round per Rank (Will save negates).

name: Elemental Focus
description: The conjuration and projection of raw thermodynamic and acoustic energies: Fire, Cold, Lightning, Sonic, and Acid.
body:
# Elemental Focus (Energy)

The conjuration and projection of raw thermodynamic and acoustic energies: Fire, Cold, Lightning, Sonic, and Acid.

### Mechanics
- **Parent Discipline**: Energy
- **Damage**: `1d6 per Discipline Stage + 1d6 per Invocation Rank`.
- **Critical Status Effects**: Pyro (lingering burn), Cryo (freeze/snare), Voltic (electric stun), Sonic (concussive stun), Corrosive (dissolve DR).

name: Enhancement Focus
description: Reinforcing structural integrity, hardening natural armor, sharpening blades, and boosting biological attributes.
body:
# Enhancement Focus (Matter)

Reinforcing structural integrity, hardening natural armor, sharpening blades, and boosting biological attributes.

### Mechanics
- **Parent Discipline**: Matter
- **Hardening / Barkskin**: Grants `+1 DR per 3 Ranks` to armor or natural skin.
- **Physical Boost**: Grants `+2` to Strength, Agility, or Stamina for 1 min/Rank.

# Force Focus (Energy)

The telekinetic manipulation of kinetic vectors, force fields, and invisible concussive constructs.

### Mechanics
- **Parent Discipline**: Energy
- **Damage**: `1d8 per Discipline Stage + 1d8 per Invocation Rank` (Force damage).
- **Telekinesis**: Lift and throw weight equal to `25 lbs x Rank`.
- **Force Field**: Grants Temporary Health equal to `5 x Rank`.
description: The telekinetic manipulation of kinetic vectors, force fields, and invisible concussive constructs.
name: Force Focus
Order Focus
description: Restoring biological patterns, cellular healing, critical stabilization, and abjuration wards.
body:
# Order Focus (Entropy)

Restoring biological patterns, cellular healing, critical stabilization, and abjuration wards.

### Mechanics
- **Parent Discipline**: Entropy
- **Healing**: `2d6 per Discipline Stage + 1d6 per Invocation Rank` (Restores Health / Vitality).
- **Stabilize**: Immediate reaction prevents death when character reaches 0 HP.
- **Restoration**: Cleanses poisons, diseases, and status conditions based on severity DC.

# Phantasm Focus (Illusion)

Pure sensory deception: holographic glamer, active invisibility, auditory dampening, and phantom scenes.

### Mechanics
- **Parent Discipline**: Illusion
- **Disbelief**: Target making a successful Will save sees through and negates the illusion entirely.
- **Invisibility**: Bends light around subject (1 min/Rank); attacking breaks concealment.
description: Pure sensory deception: holographic glamer, active invisibility, auditory dampening, and phantom scenes.
name: Phantasm Focus

body:
# Projection Focus (Mental)

Sending telepathic thoughts, psionic domination commands, neural mind blasts, and altering memories.

### Mechanics
- **Parent Discipline**: Mental
- **Range**: Extended (`100ft x Rank`).
- **Mind Blast**: Inflicts `1d6 Psychic damage per Rank` + Stun condition (Will save for half).
- **Domination**: Forces target to obey verbal commands (Will save negates).
description: Sending telepathic thoughts, psionic domination commands, neural mind blasts, and altering memories.
name: Projection Focus

body:
# Sense Focus (Mental)

Receiving extrasensory information: clairvoyance, remote viewing, surface thought reading, and precognitive glimpses.

### Mechanics
- **Parent Discipline**: Mental
- **Precognition**: Grants Advantage on an upcoming Initiative roll or specific Defense check.
- **Clairvoyance**: Projects sight and hearing to any known location within range.
name: Sense Focus
description: Receiving extrasensory information: clairvoyance, remote viewing, surface thought reading, and precognitive glimpses.

name: Shadow Focus
body:
# Shadow Focus (Illusion)

Infusing sensory illusions with quasi-real matter drawn from the Shadow Plane.

### Mechanics
- **Parent Discipline**: Illusion
- **Quasi-Reality**: Even when disbelieved via Will save, Shadow illusions retain 20% reality, solid impact, and damage.
- **Shadow Conjuration**: Duplicates other summon or evocation spells at 50% power.
description: Infusing sensory illusions with quasi-real matter drawn from the Shadow Plane.
The dimensional art of calling forth creatures, objects, and spatial matter across coordinates and planes.
name: Summoning Focus
body:
# Summoning Focus (Dimension)

The dimensional art of calling forth creatures, objects, and spatial matter across coordinates and planes.

### Mechanics
- **Parent Discipline**: Dimension
- **Duration**: 1 Round per Discipline Rank (Sustained). Spending 1 Karma Point extends duration to 1 Minute per Rank.
- **Summon Creature**: Summons entities with Build Point (BP) budget equal to `10 + (Invocation Rank x 5)`.
- **Create Object**: Manifests items of Simple complexity (CR 0); higher ranks increase complexity and Tech Level.

name: Teleport Focus
body:
# Teleport Focus (Dimension)

Instantaneous physical relocation across space without traversing intervening terrain.

### Mechanics
- **Parent Discipline**: Dimension
- **Familiarity DC**: Very Familiar (DC 5), Seen Once (DC 15), Description Only (DC 25), Blind / Unknown (DC 30).
- **Tactical Blink**: Move `10ft + 5ft/Rank` as a Move Action without provoking Attacks of Opportunity.
description: Instantaneous physical relocation across space without traversing intervening terrain.

body:
# Transmutation Focus (Matter)

Changing one physical substance into another, state changes (solid/liquid/gas), petrification, and biological polymorphing.

### Mechanics
- **Parent Discipline**: Matter
- **Polymorph**: Subject takes on the physical stat array of a beast or alternate species.
- **Petrification**: Fortitude save vs turning to stone; partial success inflicts Slowed condition.
description: Changing one physical substance into another, state changes (solid/liquid/gas), petrification, and biological polymorphing.
name: Transmutation Focus
